# FormattingRouteParitySweepTests ratchet (P22e, issue 2168).
# One row per failing (stem, twin, route, state, bucket):  stem twin route state bucket # #issue
# A row covers every cell of that route and state on that stem and twin. A row whose (route, state) ran
# and now holds, or has no cell, fails the sweep: delete it (drain on fix). Populated from a FULL-mode run
# (SHARPY_ROUTE_SWEEP_FULL=1, the FMTROUTE-ROW lines of the test output). cli and full rows on S1/S2 are
# refused by the loader. Phases 2-3 of P22e drain this file to empty.
# Buckets (T = the applied text, D = the document):
#   edits        the edit list is not legal for D (the strict applier threw)
#   net          CheckMeaningPreserved(D, ast(D), T) refuses T: the applied text changes the program
#   whole        cli/full/range-whole: T differs from Format(D) (full modulo line breaks; CRLF kept on range-whole)
#   local        range kinds: T is neither D nor D with the selection's hunks applied
#   fixedPoint   S1: a route edits a document that is already Format's fixed point
#   ontypeShape  ontype: T differs from D other than in the requested line's leading whitespace
# Unparseable documents (S3 cut after a block opener, S4 cut inside a multi-line literal, S5 an unmatched
# triple quote inserted as line 0), ground truth from the parent twin's clean lex:
#   content      a line is lost or gained, or changed beyond its leading whitespace
#   literal      a line that starts inside a literal is not identical
#   depth        a logical line's block depth in T (the lexer's width rule) differs from its depth in the parent
